WHAT: Test script that validates the curator prompt against fake conversations
WHERE: /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/memory/test-curator.ts
HOW: `bun test-curator.ts`
  - Builds real curator prompt (with existing memories + primer injected)
  - Feeds fake conversation transcript
  - Sets MEMORY_CURATOR_ACTIVE=1 to block hook firing
  - Parses JSON from claude -p output (handles markdown code fence wrapping)
  - Shows extracted memories with scope, type, tags, triggers
  - Flags suspect extractions (keywords that shouldn't have fired)
  - Reports missing expected content
WHY: No way to iterate on curator prompt without test harness
GOTCHA: claude -p wraps JSON in markdown code fences — parser must strip them
PROVEN: 3 test scenarios, all produced exactly 1 global (legit collaboration rules), noise correctly filtered
